source: CMS Medicare Public Use File / data.cms.gov
reason: MeshIC audit found that the prior artifact could treat a single provider/service row as national utilization and calculated sector reimbursement with an unweighted average payment. The legacy observations were removed rather than retained as decision evidence.
method: No utilization or reimbursement values are published until code-level CMS observations are explicitly aggregated, source-resolved, and ingested through scripts/fetch-cms-utilization.ts.
disclaimer: Medicare utilization is not an all-payer market-size estimate. Missing verified aggregate data remains missing.
